caseNameFull: Helvering, Commissioner of Internal Revenue v. National Grocery Co.
attorneys: Solicitor General Reed for petitioner. Messrs. Edwin F. Smith and James D. Carpenter, Jr. for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit granted.

Mr. Justice Reed took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
